collision_review.issue: All six different accuracy/critical pairs carry the same when activated label. No levels are printed. Sequence position does not establish a rank or level.

policy: Guide claims are source observations, not independently verified live-era mechanics. Printed level labels do not establish character level, dance rank or required level. Percentages remain in verbatim observations. No identity matching, canonical ID assignment or operative import. Mirrored Telon Project provenance is not independent corroboration.
